title: 高層気層における非定型事象に関する考証 ―失われた天球測量図の断片と、浮遊型構造物の観測記録―
author: 学者 ヘルマン

en.title: Investigation of Non-Standard Phenomena in the Upper Atmosphere – Fragments of the Lost Celestial Survey and Observation
en.premise: This report details the analysis of the excavated "Secret Map" [1] and the investigation of the flight paths recorded for the "flying ships" depicted therein. The map possesses a peculiar property: it dynamically alters terrain based on the observer's perception. As the investigation progresses, evidence suggests that the drifting vessels are remnants of a once‑existing civilization's "thought residue." Readers will piece together from fragmented accounts the chilling truth that the world is being reconstructed through observation.

zh.title: 高层气层中非标准现象的调查——失落天球测绘图碎片与漂浮结构观测记录
zh.premise: 本报告记录了对挖掘出的“秘密地图”[1]的解析以及其中记载的“飞行船”航迹的调查。该地图具有一种奇特的性质：根据观察者的认知动态改变地形。随着调查的深入，逐渐暗示漂浮在空中的船只实际上是曾经存在文明的“思维残余”。读者将从零散的报告中拼凑出一个令人震惊的真相：世界正通过观测被重新构建。
